prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='DWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: CWT_rf dominates with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (59.4), while DWT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.831 correlation). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (75.37) indicates massive model disagreement, and concept drift is detected. Given high disagreement and drift, robust median/trimmed_mean combinations are safer than stacking to avoid overfitting noise while leveraging complementary trend/seasonality strengths.
